items.text: On the regional crisis text line, is the introduction of a triage and queue protocol on 11 January 2027 followed by a fall in the evening median time to first human reply and in abandoned conversations, beyond the pre-implementation trend, over the first 26 weeks?
items.population: Conversations opened on the crisis text line in evening shifts
items.intervention: Triage and queue protocol: automated first reply, keyword flag, surge roster
items.comparator: The 52 weeks before go-live (interrupted time series)
items.outcome: Weekly median time to first human reply; weekly proportion of abandoned conversations
items.time: 52 weeks before and 26 weeks after go-live
items.setting: Regional crisis text line run by a community agency with hospital psychiatry

items.text: How often is the protocol delivered as intended (flagged messages answered first, surge roster logged in within 10 minutes) and how acceptable is it to volunteers?
items.population: Queue episodes and volunteer responders after go-live
items.outcome: Fidelity proportions and volunteer acceptability scores

finer: Feasible from platform logs once the agreement is signed, within staff time and a 20-minute volunteer limit; interesting to the agency and psychiatry; novel for text lines; ethical without reading content; relevant to how the line meets people in crisis.
summary: One service-outcome question and one delivery-and-acceptance question, framed for RE-AIM.
